assertions.name: 离线Maven构建
assertions.actual: 多文件工程已离线编译并生成可执行JAR。

assertions.name: 无效身份拒绝
assertions.actual: HTTP 401 {"requestId":"073615ab-600c-4f2f-a4ac-9f7471227f64","message":"登录已失效，请重新登录","code":"SESSION_EXPIRED"}

assertions.name: 会话身份不泄露摘要
assertions.expected: alice身份，隐藏密码/令牌摘要

assertions.name: 重放已注销令牌
assertions.actual: HTTP 401 {"requestId":"d6cac8c8-9ea4-4627-b073-35e42fd47d4d","message":"登录已失效，请重新登录","code":"SESSION_EXPIRED"}

assertions.name: 会话到期
assertions.actual: HTTP 401 {"requestId":"269e1476-d199-4b2a-8210-4001842ae71f","message":"登录已失效，请重新登录","code":"SESSION_EXPIRED"}

assertions.name: 跨计划越权拒绝
assertions.actual: HTTP 403 {"requestId":"57162286-7ceb-4dfd-9636-567031be746a","message":"你不是这个计划的成员","code":"PLAN_FORBIDDEN"}

assertions.name: 任务数据越权拒绝
assertions.actual: HTTP 403 {"requestId":"962024d8-e38c-4ece-82c9-4658103a9e46","message":"你不是这个计划的成员","code":"PLAN_FORBIDDEN"}

assertions.name: 管理员不绕过成员边界
assertions.actual: HTTP 403 {"requestId":"1d7626d2-8b2d-42ff-9a2d-176615248fb2","message":"你不是这个计划的成员","code":"PLAN_FORBIDDEN"}

assertions.name: 成员无分配权限
assertions.actual: HTTP 403 {"requestId":"a8b0ad04-ced9-442c-8b08-857ed5f301e3","message":"只有计划负责人可执行此操作","code":"OWNER_REQUIRED"}

assertions.name: 普通用户无审计权限
assertions.actual: HTTP 403 {"requestId":"50939c27-a9b2-4321-b203-255753a9aef6","message":"仅管理员可查看审计记录","code":"ADMIN_REQUIRED"}

assertions.name: 创建计划与可信负责人
分页边界 page=bad
assertions.actual: HTTP 400 {"requestId":"41ca0774-3fa1-441d-abd5-c37c55a6028d","message":"请求格式或参数不正确","code":"INVALID_INPUT"}

assertions.name: 批量后项失败返回400
assertions.actual: HTTP 400 {"requestId":"eddffcaa-6745-4c51-a89e-28076f3df685","message":"被分配者不是计划成员","code":"INVALID_ASSIGNEE"}

assertions.name: 成员不能修改他人任务
assertions.actual: HTTP 403 {"requestId":"7a0aa7e5-8255-4037-870c-812a1df969ac","message":"只有计划负责人可执行此操作","code":"OWNER_REQUIRED"}
